title: Kaseya VSA 10 antivirus and Defender alerts
volume: A few a week across an MSP's clients for threats. A stopped Defender service is rare on a device that runs it.
mdr_note: These detections are yours to work. Sophos MDR doesn't work custom detections, and a case your own case rule opens from them is Managed By Self.
author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: Two custom detection rules for Kaseya VSA 10, on the third-party alert records the library's VSA 10 parsers write from its notification webhook. They make a detection when VSA 10 reports an antivirus threat, and when the Defender service stops on a device. Each rule matches sensor type Kaseya VSA 10 only.
notes:
Setup:
- Add the library's Kaseya VSA 10 parsers, and create a VSA 10 notification webhook to HTTP Ingest, as the parser entry says. Then run the check-your-data search to see events arrive.
- The Defender rule needs a Windows service monitor on WinDefend in the devices' policies.

How it works:
- The parsers write the notification's title, such as Antivirus threat detected or Windows service stopped, and its message as the summary.
- The Defender rule takes a stopped service whose message names WinDefend.

Tuning:
- To watch another security service, such as Sense for Defender for Endpoint, add it in the query itself: and (summary contains 'WinDefend' or summary contains 'Service Sense ').

Testing:
- In a lab tenant on 2026-11-23, each query returned exactly the sample lines tests.json lists in Data Lake Search, and the rules run offline on the same 3 records agreed. The samples went in with their dates moved to the day before the test, so they fell inside the search's time range.
- As live rules there, each one fired on exactly its sample lines within about a minute. The lines went in 25 minutes after the rules were made, and every rule fired on the first send.
- No Sophos detector made a detection on the lines these rules take.
- The notifications went to HTTP Ingest one per request as JSON, as the notification webhook sends them.

Known gaps:
- The notification webhook sends a device identifier but no device name, so the case names the identifier.
